workload: Generated-key notes with title, body, pinned, updated, and tint. Each sample calls ensureCreated, tracks every note, then one saveChanges. A fresh memory database is used for every sample.
os_version: Linux 6.12.94+ #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon Oct 19 22:12:29 UTC 2026
population_variance_definition: The integer floor of the population variance of the microsecond samples: sum((sample - mean)^2) / sample_count.
limitations: Linux x64 only when the AOT executable is run there. This is not macOS, Windows, Android, or iOS, and it is not a native SQLite comparison. RSS is the whole process. The earlier scenarios_10k_linux_x64.json file is a different workload and is not a delta for these samples.
